c: While Crystal Cries (XII) is active, defeating frozen enemies causes them to drop
Crystallized Souls, pickups which increase
, and

. While individually these bonuses are miniscule, the Crystallized Souls gathered can quickly increase a player's stats. The value of the Crystallized Souls increases the more the player collects because they grant Growth, which in turn increases their own value. There is also a 200-250 pickup limit for Crystallized Souls that can be on the stage at any point.
The stats provided by
Crystallized Souls are based on the base
Experience value of the enemy that dropped it. The stat bonuses provided by a Crystallized Soul are:
= 0.06 * Base XP Value
= 0.0003 * Base XP Value
= 0.03% * Base XP Value
For example, a
Skelegem, with a Base XP of 3, will drop a Crystallized Soul that gives +0.18 Max Health, +0.0009 Recovery, and +0.09% Growth.
Additionally, Crystal Cries will trigger an HP-Critical
Orologion when the character's Health hits 20%. This ability recovers once the character is healed back to full Max Health.
